description.value:
Requirements You're in Stellar Dance Stance, and your dance is at its zenith.

Just as the celestial bodies of the sun and moon align in perfect synchronicity, so too can you perform two steps of the stellar dance at once. You take any action you have from the stellar dancer archetype that requires your dance to not be at its zenith, ignoring that requirement. If that action would cause your dance to reach its zenith, your dance remains at its zenith until the end of your next turn or until you leave the stance, whichever comes first.
